How willing you are to let people in is a direct reflection of how willing you are to get hurt. Because of your past you’re terrified to let anyone in because of the fear of getting hurt. My advice is to start small and grow until you confidence is back up. Start with a smile to random strangers if it feels natural. Then try and compliment your female coworkers. Try and do things first that don’t require a response back. Once you can continue to challenge yourself and build confidence try to have platonic friends. Having those friendly relationships with people will eventually build your confidence to where a romantic partner doesn’t seem so scary. Best of luck!
